title: Communications cross-family transition research cards

transition_cards.question: A new format becomes incremental retained contribution, not just additional sessions.
transition_cards.unit_of_analysis: Task/format × geography × monetization cohort; keep owned and partner distribution distinct.
transition_cards.observable_inputs: Commercially useful activity; paid adoption; realized yield; serving and distribution cost; substitution of old activity.
transition_cards.financial_outcomes: Same-cohort or explicitly bridged net contribution; issuer allocation separately qualified.
transition_cards.economic_clock: Compare like task cohorts over the actual rollout and purchase cycle, then the matched reporting period; no universal duration.
transition_cards.falsifier: More sessions replace higher-yield activity; serving costs or capital requirements absorb the gain.
transition_cards.forbidden_shortcut: A new user interface or management AI attribution does not establish incrementality.

transition_cards.question: Retained attention improves advertiser value and sustainable monetization.
transition_cards.unit_of_analysis: Format × market × user/advertiser cohort; do not multiply mismatched audience and yield.
transition_cards.observable_inputs: Engagement/retention; impressions; yield; advertiser incrementality evidence where obtainable; creator and compute expense.
transition_cards.financial_outcomes: Cumulative retained contribution; incremental cash after required investment remains separate.
transition_cards.economic_clock: Use the recommendation experiment or cohort window and subsequent reporting periods; a one-day engagement change is not lifetime value.
transition_cards.falsifier: Lower-yield mix, excess ad load, creator payments or infrastructure offset growth.
transition_cards.forbidden_shortcut: Platform-attributed conversions are not independently measured incremental sales.

transition_cards.question: Retained customer expenditure and net fees repay the service workload.
transition_cards.unit_of_analysis: Comparable client cohort × channel × principal/agent accounting basis.
transition_cards.observable_inputs: Client spending; new versus established clients; fee basis; gross billings/net revenue; workload; settlement.
transition_cards.financial_outcomes: Retained contribution and cash after buyer/seller settlement, with exact denominator.
transition_cards.economic_clock: Campaign/budget renewal and settlement cycle; separate quarterly reporting from cash collection.
transition_cards.falsifier: Logo retention hides lower spend; apparent take-rate expansion is presentation or mix.
transition_cards.forbidden_shortcut: Partnerships and different peer growth rates do not prove a bilateral budget transfer.

transition_cards.question: Acquired households renew at an economic price and replenish content investment.
transition_cards.unit_of_analysis: Household/customer acquisition cohort × plan × territory; entitled accounts are not distinct customers.
transition_cards.observable_inputs: Effective price, renewals, downgrades, reactivations, advertising yield, content cash and amortization.
transition_cards.financial_outcomes: Retained cohort contribution; service profit; content commitments and issuer cash as separate outputs.
transition_cards.economic_clock: At least the relevant paid renewal and slate/rights cycle must be observable; choose the actual window before the study.
transition_cards.falsifier: Event cohorts leave, bundles cannibalize existing purchases, or legacy erosion offsets service improvement.
transition_cards.forbidden_shortcut: Subscriber additions or one profitable quarter do not establish sustainable cash.

transition_cards.question: Controlled rights and distribution terms generate repeat retained receipts.
transition_cards.unit_of_analysis: Right/use × territory × term × counterparty; distinguish ownership, administration and distribution.
transition_cards.observable_inputs: Signed scope; paid uses; royalty pool/basis; advances; recoupment; creator share; renewal terms.
transition_cards.financial_outcomes: Attributable receipts after obligations; returns on advances/catalog investment without double deductions.
transition_cards.economic_clock: Contract term, royalty reporting and settlement window; an announcement date is not a cash-maturity date.
transition_cards.falsifier: Higher consumption earns lower retained yield; renewal or new-right acquisition cost consumes cash.
transition_cards.forbidden_shortcut: AI agreement, streams or catalog book value do not establish launched product, fixed per-stream rate or market value.

transition_cards.question: Launch and payer cohorts repay development, distribution and creator investment.
transition_cards.unit_of_analysis: Title/platform × launch cohort × payer cohort; retain failed, refunded and withdrawn titles.
transition_cards.observable_inputs: Availability; retention; payers; spending; bookings; recognition; payouts; development and update cost.
transition_cards.financial_outcomes: Cohort contribution and portfolio development recovery; issuer cash separately qualified.
transition_cards.economic_clock: Predeclare launch/cohort windows and recognition lag; a launch window and a franchise life are different targets.
transition_cards.falsifier: Engagement improves without contribution; a title is withdrawn, refunded or dependent on expensive replenishment.
transition_cards.forbidden_shortcut: A launched or popular title is not proof of durable adoption or stock alpha.

transition_cards.question: Serviceable capacity converts into retained customer cash that repays total committed capital.
transition_cards.unit_of_analysis: Construction vintage × geography × technology × retail/wholesale relationship.
transition_cards.observable_inputs: Built/serviceable/activated locations; customer retention; realized price; cost to connect; wholesale/JV payments.
transition_cards.financial_outcomes: Cohort cash contribution, investment recovery and actual legacy shutdown savings.
transition_cards.economic_clock: Build-to-activation plus customer renewal and capital payback windows; quarter-only speed is not a lifetime return.
transition_cards.falsifier: Immature vintages distort aggregate penetration; subsidized additions, access fees or deferred maintenance absorb gains.
transition_cards.forbidden_shortcut: Coverage, homes passed and FTTx/FTTH/customer ratios are not interchangeable.

transition_cards.question: Accepted useful capacity becomes paid service that can fund replacement and financing.
transition_cards.unit_of_analysis: Authorized service × location/time × device class × customer contract.
transition_cards.observable_inputs: Launch and acceptance; availability under load; active paid use; contract scope; funding; replacement obligations.
transition_cards.financial_outcomes: Retained service cash and remaining commitments, then attributable per-share economics.
transition_cards.economic_clock: Named commissioning milestone, service period, billing and replenishment horizon; preserve changed schedules.
transition_cards.falsifier: Technical progress does not become useful paid capacity; funding or dilution absorbs project value.
transition_cards.forbidden_shortcut: A launch, memorandum, test, prepayment and recurring paid service are different observations.

transition_cards.question: Demand converts through completed events and settlement into retained contribution.
transition_cards.unit_of_analysis: Event/venue cohort × promoter/ticketing/sponsor role × event season.
transition_cards.observable_inputs: Tickets/presales; event completion; net fees; artist/venue costs; sponsorship; refund and settlement obligations.
transition_cards.financial_outcomes: Event-cohort contribution and unrestricted cash after obligations, not presale cash alone.
transition_cards.economic_clock: Actual event season and settlement tail; postpone and cancel are distinct outcomes.
transition_cards.falsifier: More attendance with worse terms; cancellations, refunds or venue capital consume earnings.
transition_cards.forbidden_shortcut: One event viewed through three roles is not three independent increments of end-demand.

transition_cards.question: Content/distribution economics hold over a complete rights or release cycle.
transition_cards.observable_inputs: Distribution receipts; audience monetization; rights costs; production; amortization; internal eliminations.
transition_cards.financial_outcomes: Full-cycle retained contribution and consolidated external profit/cash.
transition_cards.economic_clock: Matched event/rights seasons and external delivery periods, not mechanically annualized event quarters.
transition_cards.falsifier: Rights inflation, lost distribution or internal trading produces an apparent inflection.
transition_cards.forbidden_shortcut: Segment profit is not a disclosed profit allocation to every digital service or title.

transition_cards.question: Productivity improves retained client economics under the actual fee arrangement.
transition_cards.unit_of_analysis: Client/contract cohort × time-based, retainer, fixed-price or outcome-linked fee basis.
transition_cards.observable_inputs: Net fees versus pass-through; scope; renewals; delivery hours/costs; realized price; implementation expense.
transition_cards.financial_outcomes: Retained fees and contribution after the cost of sustaining service quality.
transition_cards.economic_clock: Delivery and contract renewal/repricing cycle; productivity may precede fee renegotiation.
transition_cards.falsifier: Fewer billable hours reduce revenue; savings accrue to the client; cheaper delivery weakens outcomes.
transition_cards.forbidden_shortcut: Automation or an AI label does not identify who retains the saving.

transition_cards.question: Paid habits and bundles replenish differentiated content and distribution investment.
transition_cards.unit_of_analysis: Subscriber cohort × product bundle × billing interval × geography.
transition_cards.observable_inputs: Effective price; renewals; bundle overlap; engagement; content expense; ad/referral/licensing scope.
transition_cards.financial_outcomes: Retained contribution per unique customer and cash after content investment.
transition_cards.economic_clock: Actual billing/renewal and content-investment period; preserve 28-day versus calendar-month measures.
transition_cards.falsifier: Bundles discount customers who would stay; multiple product entitlements inflate user growth.
transition_cards.forbidden_shortcut: Combined affiliate/licensing/other revenue is not a disclosed AI-licensing share.

regime_channels.inputs: Household real purchasing power, advertiser/customer budgets, renewal intent, order/price data.
regime_channels.transmission: Advertiser spend, customer churn and net fees; geography and budget mix matter.
regime_channels.forbidden_shortcut: A lower yield does not prove stronger spending.
regime_channels.clock: Budget/renewal cadence plus actual release lag.

regime_channels.inputs: Matched-currency real/nominal curve and model-qualified expectations/term-premium decomposition.
regime_channels.transmission: Value of a fixed cash stream versus changed growth/cash assumptions; keep both.
regime_channels.forbidden_shortcut: A Treasury-rate change is not automatically the whole discount-rate change.
regime_channels.clock: Market observation timestamp; cash flows retain their own dates.

regime_channels.inputs: Maturity schedule, floating/fixed mix, issuer spread, leases, partner and funding claims.
regime_channels.transmission: Expense/cash effect only on debt that reprices or is refinanced; liquidity matters separately.
regime_channels.forbidden_shortcut: Cheaper government funding is not cheaper issuer funding if spreads widen enough.
regime_channels.clock: Reset/maturity date and conditional funding need.

regime_channels.inputs: Effective customer prices; content/rights, labor, network energy, serving and acquisition costs.
regime_channels.transmission: Retained spread and ability to pass through costs; cost floors and minimums can make it nonlinear.
regime_channels.forbidden_shortcut: Nominal revenue growth is not necessarily real demand or margin expansion.
regime_channels.clock: Contract resets, hedges and input procurement periods.

regime_channels.inputs: Demand, cost, funding and reporting currencies; geographic segment exposure; hedge/contract terms.
regime_channels.transmission: Local demand, translation, transaction and financing effects separately.
regime_channels.forbidden_shortcut: Domicile or listing currency does not establish the operating-currency exposure.
regime_channels.clock: Relevant average/spot/contract rate for the measure; preserve reported assumptions.

regime_channels.inputs: Effective privacy/distribution rules, rights terms, spectrum and service permissions.
regime_channels.transmission: Access, distribution fees, ad measurement, content cost and timing to service.
regime_channels.forbidden_shortcut: A proposed rule or company lobbying statement is not an effective constraint.
regime_channels.clock: Effective dates, territory, transition rules and compliance timing.

regime_channels.inputs: Accepted supply, build cost, usable capacity, qualified vendor terms and remaining commitments.
regime_channels.transmission: Time to monetization, minimum scale, utilization and replacement-adjusted contribution.
regime_channels.forbidden_shortcut: Cheaper unit hardware does not prove lower cost per unit of accepted service.
regime_channels.clock: Construction, commissioning, activation and replacement cohorts.

regime_channels.inputs: Owner-qualified revisions, valuation inputs, positioning/flows, relative performance and breadth.
regime_channels.transmission: Market confirmation or divergence alongside the operating thesis, not inside the source fact.
regime_channels.forbidden_shortcut: A rising price cannot independently corroborate the operating feature used to predict that price.
regime_channels.clock: Exact instrument/market session and estimate vintage.

fixed_examples.lesson: Government yields fall; total borrowing cost rises. Apply only to the assumed repricing principal; no issuer forecast.
With a level perpetuity assumed, falling cash and a falling discount rate can offset; there is no universal rate-only direction.
The same discount-rate change produces a loss with weaker cash. Cash figures and model are wholly invented.
Show coverage and outcomes. Neither delete unresolved observations nor count them automatically as failures; no statistical interval or real win rate.
Repeated evidence is not ten independent confirmations.
A period can end before its result is disclosed. Review date, target and observation date are not equivalent.
A changed plan informs the new thesis but does not erase the original forecast obligation.
Concord is a failed-launch/withdrawal case, not evidence of a known development budget or a validated equity trade.
An operational outcome needs an accepted resolver; do not force it into a price-return or greater-than-63-session grade.
Missing stronger claims does not erase narrower valid analysis.
A theme can improve in adoption while its profit and investment outcomes remain unresolved.
A reporting change is not automatically a change in the business lifecycle.

P02.basis: inherited research; not re-audited this pass

N01.basis: native source read; selected owner/clock/identity declarations

N02.basis: native lines 1-170 inspected; not full execution

N03.basis: measurement-law/ownership evidence; historical runtime entries are not fresh liveness

N04.basis: one ThemeState owner; no current runtime claim

W01.basis: methodology opened; no authenticated API call or new dataset ingestion

W02.basis: methodology opened; no current rate or term-premium estimate adopted

W03.basis: official dated announcement opened; selected removal/refund statements

W04.basis: methodology searched/read; vintage changes do not enumerate unchanged releases

limits: No real forecasts, probabilities, canonical theme IDs, claims, lifecycle writes or authority flags are produced.
Research IDs are document labels, not native runtime or evidence identities.
Existing sixty A1 CRV obligations are unchanged.
No new scheduler, watcher, publication or evaluation system.
